text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Nice one, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Your guts are your calling card, Kitasan
Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank... Thank yoooou!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's running is even more
powerful
than before, and it's drawing
the crowd's eye right
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her performance here has become a
great
catalyst for pulling in more fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are Kitasan Black's trainer, yes?
May I have a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wish to speak with her. That is, I wish to
speak
with the ace of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for bothering you right after
your
race. I only wish for a quick word.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First, I must commend you for your
performance.
Last year, you were only
able to break through
the ranks by sheer
force of will...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But today, your overall form was
flawless. I can
sense limitless potential in
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black. There is no doubt that
you are a
superb Umamusume who will
come to define a
generation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...O-oh? Thank you, but I'm really not
that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But that is exactly why I feel so
frustrated that
Brusquement was unable
to race in the Kikuka
Sho last year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It pains me that she could not partake in
the final
race of the Classics. Do you not
feel the same?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you say we make up for last
year and
finally settle the score, so both
of you can move
forward without any
lingering regrets?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... Are... are you asking if I
want to run
against Brusquement?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to run against her! I felt so
conflicted
on the day of the Kikuka Sho
last year...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to wrap up the unfinished
business we left
behind, and face off
with Brusquement with all
the feelings
we've been holding on to!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good... I'm glad to hear that.
Brusquement is of
the same mind. Since
you are both in agreement,
we will do
our best to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me for the intrusion. Until next
we meet...
at Nigawa.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nigawa? Um, Trainer? Why did she bring
up
Nigawa?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin... Oh! She must be talking about
the
Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list: 仁川……つまり『阪神レース場』だ
仁川……つまり『阪神レース場』だよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stage for their showdown is set.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer, I thought today's
race was
going to be the biggest
mountain I'd have to
conquer this
spring...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But it turns out an even bigger one
awaits! Next
up, it'll be me and
Brusquement at the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fire's pumping in our veins. After half a
year, our
forgotten final battle is once
again back on the
table.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Satono Diamond also finds
herself
facing her biggest spring trial.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond falls short in the
Japanese
Derby! She was close, but
unfortunately, she
came in second!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And her loss was by a mere eight
centimeters!
That's right, it was just eight
centimeters! She
really almost had it,
folks!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My cleat... Of all the times I could've
had a cleat
malfunction, why here at
such an important race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I already lost at the Satsuki Sho, and
now I've lost
the Derby... But I can't lose.
I can't, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll break this jinx if it's the last thing I
do. Even if
it means I have to put my life
on the line.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Those last eight centimeters are because
of my
weakness!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black isn't the only one who's
growing.
Satono Diamond is as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hopes of her family rest heavily on
Satono
Diamond's shoulders, but she
looks on, her regal
expression fierce with
determination.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to get my cleats refitted in
preparation
for fall. There must be more
I can do to reduce
the possibility of
another accident.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to be more diligent about
checking in
with my own health and
body. But most
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I need the strength to win, fully cleated
or not. I
need to be strong enough to
stand firm and
dispel that curse!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Dia! I'm facing a wall
that's just
as insurmountable.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to have to run against a
prodigy
Umamusume, but I'm not going
to lose!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You'd better watch me as I take on the

Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Massive walls loom before the both of
them,
barring their paths. Kitasan Black
will go first in
confronting her
obstacle—the Takarazuka Kinen.
